title: Central Railway Recruitment 2026 – Railway Advocate Posts
shortInfo: Central Railway has announced notification for Railway Advocate posts. Required qualification: Degree in Law (LL.B.). Last date to apply: 23-10-26.

Attach self-attested copies of all required documents: (i) Degree in Law and any other higher qualifications, (ii) Enrolment Certificate issued by the Bar Council (Valid and Current), (iii) Experience Certificate duly endorsed by the Chairman of the concerned Bar Association, (iv) Reported/Referred judgements in reputed legal journals or databases in matters handled in individual capacity in last 3 years.

Application will not be considered if any one of the mandatory documents is not enclosed.
Incomplete applications and those not fulfilling the requisite conditions shall be summarily rejected without any further correspondence.
